1.20.betting_forecast: 11/4 Calico Blue, 4/1 Black Star Boy, 9/2 Hypnotised, Old Is Gold, 7/1 Atticum, 9/1 Ambishio, 10/1 Underwriter, 20/1 One And
1.20.spotlight_verdict: Having been headstrong last year, a gelding operation may be a positive for BLACK STAR BOY who showed considerable promise when winning a maiden at Newbury last September. He earns the vote ahead of Atticum, who impressed at Yarmouth last October and returns with his yard in good form. The well-bred Hypnotised is third choice, while the in-form Ambishio could go well once more.[Ben Hutton]

1.50.betting_forecast: 11/10 Organise, 11/4 Nobody Knows, 13/2 Look To The Stars, 7/1 Laureate Crown, 12/1 Capall Rasa, 20/1 Goodwood Galaxy,
1.50.spotlight_verdict: The Gosden stable won this last year with Fifth Column, who won a further two handicaps later in the season, and the yard's unbeaten and well-bred Organise is a leading contender on his handicap debut. However, NOBODY KNOWS also arrives 2-2 and has shaped as though he could well be superior to his opening mark. Laureate Crown is third choice with last month's win at Wolverhampton having been franked by the clear runner-up.[Ben Hutton]

3.35.betting_forecast: 6/4 Action, 5/2 Wise Prince, 7/2 Raaheeb, 9/1 Al Zanati, 14/1 Spyce, 20/1 Oceans Four, 33/1 Winding Stream.
3.35.spotlight_verdict: As is often the case in a Classic trial, the dilemma is whether to side with form or potential. The latter is represented by the very interesting prospects RAAHEEB (narrowly preferred) and Wise Prince, while Futurity runner-up Action sets the standard and isn't opposed with absolute confidence.[Steve Boow]

4.10.betting_forecast: 11/10 Sunshine Star, 5/2 Ribbon Of Sea, 5/1 Felicitas, 12/1 Bintsaleh, Ladykirk, 14/1 Ruby Wedding, 20/1 Alma Latina, 33/1
4.10.spotlight_verdict: Several of these fillies are entered in the Oaks and/or have potential. The signs look particularly good for SUNSHINE STAR who is first choice ahead of similar type Ladykirk. Godolphin runner Ribbon Of Sea may be only third choice but she commands respect, as do a couple of the others. Alma Latina may prove best of the newcomers.[Steve Boow]

4.45.betting_forecast: 9/4 Lost Boys, 100/30 Into The Light, Magic Trip, 11/2 Bnaider, 6/1 Colourband, 12/1 The Joker.
4.45.spotlight_verdict: All of these are open to improvement but MAGIC TRIP (nap) looked a good prospect for this sort of distance when keeping on well for third over 1m at Kempton this month, and he's taken to make a winning handicap debut. The extra yardage should also suit Lost Boy who is second choice ahead of Godolphin colt Into The Light.[Ben Hutton]
